$description: Vintage brand node: palette sampled from the color emblem (assets/brand/vintage-logo-color.png), the display face, and the WoW semantic tokens (item quality, class, role, signup status). Not exported on its own; the theme nodes below it set surfaces and text.

dev.vintage.node.name: vintage
dev.vintage.node.source: assets/brand/vintage-logo-color.png; Blizzard item quality and class colors

gold.$description: Letterforms on the emblem. 100–500 are sampled lightness bands (90th → 10th percentile); 700 and 900 are derived for text on parchment.

300.$description: Sampled: letter face (median). The brand gold.

700.$description: Derived: antique gold dark enough for text on parchment.

crimson.$description: The tag behind the letters. 500–900 are sampled; 300 is derived so crimson reads as text on dark surfaces.

300.$description: Derived: crimson lifted for text on iron.

700.$description: Sampled: tag body (median). The brand crimson.

iron.$description: The frame and chain. All sampled from the emblem's low-saturation pixels.

parchment.$description: Derived: the AFD cream warmed toward the emblem gold (PLAN §3.8: cream becomes parchment).

100.$description: Derived: parchment canvas; also text on iron.

400.$description: Derived: faded ink; muted text on iron.

leather.$description: Derived: dark leather inks for text on parchment.

700.$description: Derived: worn leather; muted text on parchment.

900.$description: Derived: dark leather; body text on parchment.

display.$description: Fantasy-inscription display face. Cinzel (OFL) stands in for Friz Quadrata, which is licensed; the addon keeps Friz via FenUI. Self-host; final pick with Q12.

quality.$description: Blizzard item quality colors. Shown on dark WoW frames in every theme.

class.$description: Blizzard's standard class colors. Shown on dark WoW frames in every theme.

role.$description: Raid roles. Tuned for text on iron; parchment overrides them darker.

signup.$description: Signup status. Tuned for text on iron; parchment overrides them darker.

bench.$description: Benched: available, not in the comp.

wow-frame.$description: Dark WoW-style frame for item tooltips and class-colored names. Stays dark in every theme so Blizzard colors keep their meaning.

logo.$description: Two-tone logo (assets/brand/vintage-logo-two-tone.svg): map --vintage-logo-ink and --vintage-logo-paper to these.
